name: Aetheria Gastronomy
description: Experience a culinary journey beyond time and space. Aetheria blends molecular gastronomy with zero-gravity aesthetics to redefine the dining experience in 2026.

menu.name: Plasma Scallops
menu.description: Searing scallops with bioluminescent citrus foam and neon radish.

menu.name: Cyber-Steak 2.0
menu.description: Lab-grown wagyu with carbon-infused butter and digital truffle essence.

menu.name: The Event Horizon Burger
menu.description: Black charcoal bun, synthetic gold leaf, and pressurized onion rings.

menu.name: Liquid Nitrogen Mousse
menu.description: Sub-zero chocolate sphere that shatters upon sonic resonance.

menu.name: Supernova Cocktail
menu.description: Floating gin pearls in a shimmering violet elderflower nebula.

menu.name: Nebula Risotto
menu.description: Algae-infused rice with crystalline parmesan and space-dust saffron.

testimonials.name: Dr. Elara Vance
testimonials.text: The flavor profiles at Aetheria are quite literally out of this world. It's the only place where science and soul truly collide.

testimonials.name: Kaelen Voss
testimonials.text: The aesthetic alone is worth the interstellar journey. Every dish is a masterpiece of digital-organic fusion.

testimonials.name: Sarah Chen
testimonials.text: Finally, a restaurant that understands the 2026 palate. It's precise, clean, and utterly revolutionary.
